d: Take a delicious journey through America's local food scene with Guy Fieri! From neighborhood diners and iconic drive-ins to independent restaurants with distinctive menus, every visit reveals a new side of American food culture. Go behind the scenes to see how chefs prepare their signature specialties before Guy gets to the tasting table. Packed with local food discoveries, restaurant highlights, and classic American comfort food, this collection is perfect for fans of food tours and cooking shows.
